programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A noble martial arts student, whose master and peers are murdered by a bloodthirsty karate expert, embarks on a tough training regime so as to avenge them.

programme.title: The Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Adapted from real events, the story is about a police special team fighting underground criminal organizations with wit and bravery, finally wiping out the enemy.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: When two brothers escape poverty to make their fortune in Shanghai, they befriend a powerful mobster and end up battling rival gangs.

programme.title: Executioners
programme.desc: An evil deformed villain controls Hong Kong's scarce water supply, so the trio of Wonder Woman, Thief Catcher and Invisible Woman must team up and save the city.

programme.title: A World Without Thieves
programme.desc: While con man Bo and femme fatale Li swindle their way across China, Li suddenly decides to leave Bo. However, their encounter with Fu Gen changes their fate forever.

programme.title: The Best of Best
programme.desc: Jie has joined the SDU and vows to uphold law and justice. However, as he falls in love with the daughter of a triad boss who killed his father, he is torn between love, family and duty.

programme.title: Whampoa Blues
programme.desc: Cong and Jin are students of the Whampoa Military Training School. While there, they accidentally discover an ammunition smuggling plan, putting their lives in danger.

programme.title: Skinny Tiger & Fatty Dragon
programme.desc: Detective Baldy and his partner Fatty stumble upon the robbery of a jewelry store, which puts them on the trail of a triad crime syndicate.

programme.title: The Hidden Enforcers
programme.desc: A retired police officer trains four assassins to punish wrongdoers who escape conviction. However, his good intentions turn sour when the assassins kill the cops.

programme.title: Return To The 36th Chamber
programme.desc: Workers of a factory have their pay cut. Desperate for their full wages, they hire an actor to impersonate a priest and kung-fu expert from the temple of Shaolin.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung.

programme.title: The Tigers
programme.desc: Five cops find their careers and their lives in jeopardy when they accept a 10 million dollar bribe from a drug smuggler, to release him from custody during a drug bust.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The film pays tribute to generations of stuntmen, including current super stars, who designed and delivered some of the most spectacular death-defying kung fu moves on-screen.

programme.title: Guns & Roses
programme.desc: Jin Shui risks everything to save his family, fleeing France with the help of his friend. Amid challenges, Jin Shui faces a dilemma: love or loyalty to his friend.

programme.title: The Monkey King
programme.desc: The Monkey King emerges after the Goddess Nuwa's sacrifice to challenge the Jade Emperor. This leads to chaos that enables Buffalo Demon to wage war in heaven.

programme.title: Twin Dragons
programme.desc: When long-lost twins, famous pianist John and criminal Boomer, reunite in Hong Kong and accidentally swap lives, Boomer vows to save John from the clutches of gangsters.

programme.title: Colour of the Loyalty
programme.desc: A triad boss' elite guards are tasked with protecting him from assassination. As one guard witnesses the elimination of other triad bosses, he unravels a huge conspiracy.

programme.title: Helios
programme.desc: When the notorious criminal, Helios steals a powerful weapon from South Korea and attempts to sell it in Hong Kong, the police forces of these two lands must join hands.

programme.title: Once A Gangster
programme.desc: Two former gangsters are tapped to run in an election for leader of the triad gang, but both want to preserve their peaceful lives. Each must outwit the other to win.

programme.title: Bullets Over Summer
programme.desc: Two unorthodox and reckless detectives who use a demented granny's apartment as a stakeout location develop romantic relationships with her neighbours.

programme.title: Dragon Squad
programme.desc: A veteran cop leads a team of Interpol agents to track down ruthless mercenaries who kidnapped an accused crime lord on his way to court.

programme.title: 3AM The Campsite
programme.desc: A group of friends going on a camping trip inside a haunted forest encounters a series of paranormal events. When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Rebellious Na Cha kills the Dragon King's son, sparking divine wrath. After a sacrifice, he is reborn more powerful than ever and rises to fight for justice.

programme.title: Duel Of Fist
programme.desc: David Chiang & Ti Lung star as 2 skilled boxers in this martial arts masterpiece of gambling and revenge from the legendary Chang Cheh.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man is forced to leave home and work to support his family by teaching martial arts skills for self-defense.

programme.title: The Heroic Trio
programme.desc: Newborn babies destined to be emperors are kidnapped by the Evil Master. The police are powerless, so the city must be saved by three women with superb fighting skills.

programme.title: Martial Arts Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Jet Li weasels out of the Shaolin temple to assassinate a despotic ruler at the ruler's extravagant public birthday celebration.

programme.title: Fire of Conscience
programme.desc: Detective Manfred teams up with Inspector Kee to investigate a homicide. As corruption surfaces, Manfred unravels a web of deceit that puts the Hong Kong Police Force at risk.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: A bitter princess kills a man and his mistress and separates their twin babies. One is raised by villains, and the other is raised by her to unknowingly kill his own brother.

programme.title: The Sniper
programme.desc: A police sniper teams up with a hot-headed rookie to take down his former friend and teammate who is exacting revenge on the police.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Dr Lam diagnoses the latest phenomenon as more citizens become 'infected'. He decides to stop the vampires from turning more citizens.
